headline: Melexis posts a Claude-based AMS verification internship for automotive sensor ICs
fact: Melexis posted Bevaix internship/master’s-thesis project 3932 for automotive sensor IC mixed-signal design verification and system integration. The six-month 2027 project assigns Claude Code workflows, test-case development, and automated classification and root-cause analysis of simulation/verification failures. SystemVerilog/Verilog is essential; UVM is beneficial. Optional work compares Chipstack with Claude. Deployment into real projects and efficiency improvements are expected project results, not demonstrated outcomes. The official timestamp is October 5 at 20:00 UTC, corresponding to October 6 JST; 2027 is the work cohort.

sources.title: Melexis Careers: AI Infrastructure Development for Automotive Sensor IC Design Verification (3932)
sources.summary: Official JobPosting metadata gives datePosted 2026-10-05T20:00:00+00:00 and identifier 3932. The Event uses October 6 JST. Duties explicitly concern mixed-signal test development and verification-failure triage with Claude, not only simulation execution or real-chip measurements.
